BeneficiaryType.name: Beneficiary Type
BeneficiaryType.definition: Information about the recipient of the drawdown, when not the original pension holder.

CrystallisationAmount.name: Crystallisation Amount
CrystallisationAmount.definition: Amount that was originally designated for crystallisation.

PercentageOfTotalTransferValue.name: Percentage Of Total Transfer Value
PercentageOfTotalTransferValue.definition: Percentage of the total transfer value covered by the drawdown.

ApplicableRules.name: Applicable Rules
ApplicableRules.definition: Specifies the rules that are applicable to the drawdown. For example, in the UK market, the pre-A-day rule that was introduced on 6 April 2006.)

Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.definition: Information about the recipient of the drawdown, when not the original pension holder.

TriggeredDate.name: Triggered Date
TriggeredDate.definition: Date on which the drawdown was triggered when the drawdown type is flexible.

EventDate.name: Event Date
EventDate.definition: Date on which the crystallisation event was triggered.

DrawdownAmount.name: Drawdown Amount
DrawdownAmount.definition: Amount that was originally designated for drawdown.

LifetimeAllowance.name: Lifetime Allowance
LifetimeAllowance.definition: Percentage of the lifetime allowance (LTA) used.
